sections.title: ASUS ZenBook Duo
content: La magia de este ASUS ZenBook Duo radica en su versatilidad multi-pantalla. Integra dos pantallas OLED Lumina de 14 pulgadas que transforman la forma en que trabajas, ya sea diseñando o multitarea extrema. Sorprende con su manejabilidad, transportándolo fácilmente gracias a su peso ligero y delgadez. Ideal para aquellos que buscan dinamismo en sus proyectos.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1524 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Multi-Screen Versatility — Find the mode that best suits your task and seamlessly switch between them. Expand your workspace with Dual Screen or Desktop Mode, share content effortlessly in Sharing Mode, or snap everything back into one for Laptop Mode

Everything-Built-In Portability — At 3.64 lb and a mere 0.57” thin, the DUO elevates portable dual-screen setups to the next level. With a detachable Bluetooth keyboard and built-in kickstand, you can take the Zenbook DUO just as you would with any laptop — plus a FHD IR front camera

Powerfully Productive — The Zenbook DUO delivers powerful performance and AI-ready features on Windows 11. The ultra-fast Intel Core Ultra 9 285H processor with Intel AI Boost NPU paired with Intel Arc graphics, enhances tasks with AI capabilities. With 1TB SSD storage and 32GB LPDDR5x RAM, you can explore more seamlessly

Dual 14” Lumina OLED Displays — Immerse yourself in unparalleled visuals with the Zenbook DUO's dual 16:10 touch displays boasting a 2880 x 1800 resolution, vibrant 500-nit HDR peak brightness, smooth 120Hz refresh rate, and Pantone validated 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy

Military-Grade Durability — Meeting US MIL-STD 810H military standards1, the Zenbook DUO ensures unmatched reliability in harsh conditions. Rigorous testing enhances longevity, guaranteeing that your laptop is ready for work, travel, or relaxation both today and in the future

sections.title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Studio
content: Frente a otras opciones del mercado, el Microsoft Surface Laptop Studio ofrece una relación calidad-precio excepcional. Con gráficos NVIDIA GeForce RTX, transforma creatividad y rendimiento al máximo nivel por un precio competitivo. Perfecto para tareas complejas y exigentes, redefiniendo tu experiencia digital.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1399 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
visuals: Product image: Microsoft Surface Laptop Studio
features: The most powerful Surface Laptop. Quad-core powered 11th Gen Intel Core H Series processors handle your most complex workloads.

Design, animate, and render at top speed. Step up to the award-winning Ampere — NVIDIA's 2nd gen RTX architecture, enabling ray-traced graphics and cutting-edge AI features from NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti.
Boundary-pushing design with sleek 14.4“ (5) touchscreen makes seamless transitions from laptop to entertainment-ready stage to portable creative canvas.
Pair with Surface Slim Pen 2* for the best digital pen experience yet, featuring the feeling of pen on paper(7). Magnetically attach, store, and charge under the front of the keyboard.

sections.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Fold
content: -Impresionante- ligereza de apenas 2.54 libras hace al Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Fold ultra-portátil sin sacrificar potencia. Un procesador Intel Core Ultra junto con un TB de almacenamiento brindan velocidad incuestionable, ideal para presentaciones impactantes e interactividad fluida.
-Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los...- 1524 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
visuals: Product image: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Fold
features: ULTRA-FAST PERFORMANCE: Power through demanding tasks with the latest Intel Core Ultra 7 processor, 32GB of high-speed memory, and a massive 1TB solid-state drive for lightning-fast application launches and seamless multitasking.
STUNNING TOUCH DISPLAY: Enjoy brilliant clarity and responsive touch control on the 14-inch WUXGA screen, perfect for presentations, creative work, and intuitive navigation with your fingertips.

PREMIUM BUSINESS PORTABILITY: Weighing just 2.54 pounds and under 0.63 inches thin, this sleek carbon-fiber laptop is designed for professionals on the move, combining robust durability with effortless all-day carry.
COMPREHENSIVE CONNECTIVITY: Stay connected everywhere with the latest Wireless 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, and easily hook up to monitors and peripherals with dual Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, and HDMI 2.1 ports.

ENTERPRISE-GRADE SECURITY: Work with peace of mind thanks to the integrated fingerprint reader, infrared camera with physical shutter for Windows Hello facial login, and the trusted, pre-installed Windows 11 Pro operating system.
